classroom_meta_title: Eddy Classroom — digital platform for lesson prep and delivery
classroom_meta_description: Eddy Classroom is a single digital environment for teachers: ready-made lesson plans, a library of 3D materials, testing, and per-lesson analytics. Works offline, grades 1–12.

classroom_why_items.title: Everything for the lesson in one place
classroom_why_items.text: Lessons, a material library, tests — no more juggling a dozen separate apps and websites.

classroom_why_items.title: Instant answer log
classroom_why_items.text: The teacher sees who's making mistakes and where, right during the lesson — no waiting to grade notebooks.

classroom_why_items.title: 3D content library
classroom_why_items.text: Material that makes the lesson up to 100% more effective and adds interactivity.

classroom_why_items.title: AI assistant for teachers
classroom_why_items.text: A resource that helps organize and build a lesson faster.

classroom_why_items.title: Works without a stable internet connection
classroom_why_items.text: Lesson materials are downloaded in advance and open offline.

classroom_why_items.title: One app for every device
classroom_why_items.text: The teacher's laptop and tablet, any student smartphone, the classroom's interactive panel.

classroom_platform_title: What's in the Eddy Classroom platform

classroom_platform_items.title: Web version for teachers and administrators
classroom_platform_items.text: Course and lesson prep, working with the library, a test and quiz builder with different question types, viewing results and the session log.

classroom_platform_items.title: The whole group takes the test together
classroom_platform_items.text: The class answers at the same time and the teacher watches a live table: who is on which question, who got it wrong, and what they scored. One button ends the test.
classroom_platform_items.shot_alt: A shared test session: the class answer table beside the question and its options

classroom_platform_items.title: Easy student access
classroom_platform_items.text: Once joined to a course, a student can easily browse its materials, complete assignments, and take tests.

classroom_platform_items.title: Interactive panel and whiteboard
classroom_platform_items.text: Front-of-class display of presentations, video, documents, 3D models and simulations; draw and annotate directly over the material in real time.

classroom_platform_items.title: Analytics and a lesson-effectiveness dashboard
classroom_platform_items.text: A clear overview of class engagement and material mastery, with recommendations for the teacher based on session results.

classroom_platform_items.title: In-lesson game tools
classroom_platform_items.text: A wheel of names for random student selection, a timer, and a noise meter — simple tools that add dynamics to the lesson.

classroom_platform_items.title: Virtual classroom
classroom_platform_items.text: Connect students to the class remotely: browsing materials and communicating even outside the classroom.
